name: Floating Media Player
description: A Music Assistant mini player with artwork, title, progress and previous, play/pause and next buttons that floats above other apps such as Chrome, YouTube or SmartTube while Kiosk Satellite is in the background.
author: Tyreyn

settings.title: Player
settings.emptyText: Set up Music Assistant in Settings > Media Player, then press Refresh.
settings.description: The Music Assistant player the window shows and controls. Automatic follows this kiosk's own player.

settings.title: Show on the kiosk too
settings.description: Off: the window shows only above other apps and hides while a Kiosk Satellite screen is in front.

settings.title: Horizontal position
settings.description: Saved when you drag the window. -1 places it in the bottom right corner.

settings.title: Vertical position
settings.description: Saved when you drag the window. -1 places it in the bottom right corner.
